    Daltrey couldn’t take it anymore. Something drastic had 
to be done, and he knew, at last, what it was. One night during 
Townshend’s extended convalescence, the Who held a meet-
ing at their manager’s house, and Daltrey dropped the bomb:
"I don’t want to tour anymore."

ever had in his teens--maybe more—-those were the saddest 
words in the world. But if Townshend were to be stopped 
from following Who drummer Keith Moon into an early 
grave, Daltrey felt he had no other choice.
